description: Add comprehensive tests for the knowledge model, content pipeline, public content API, admin knowledge API, and sitemap endpoints
steps: Create apps/backend/tests/test_knowledge_model.py: Test KnowledgeObject model creation, field defaults, slug generation, metadata fields. Test ContentBlock, ContentMetadata, GeneratedContent sub-models with various inputs.

Create apps/backend/tests/test_content_api.py: Test public content endpoints - render endpoint returns HTML with correct headers, JSON endpoint returns proper structure, subject listing. Test 404 for non-existent content. Use mocking for MongoDB (mock KnowledgeObject.find_one, etc). Follow the pattern in test_admin_endpoints.py using TestClient + mocks.

Create apps/backend/tests/test_admin_knowledge.py: Test admin knowledge endpoints - auth guard (401 without cookie), create/update endpoint, publish endpoint triggers pipeline, list with pagination. Follow admin_cookie fixture pattern from test_admin_endpoints.py.

Create apps/backend/tests/test_content_pipeline.py: Test ContentPipeline.publish() with mocked dependencies (renderer, search indexer, HTTP calls). Verify it orchestrates steps correctly and handles partial failures gracefully.
Create apps/backend/tests/test_seo_sitemaps.py: Test sitemap endpoints return valid XML with proper content-type. Mock MongoDB queries to return sample knowledge objects.
Create apps/backend/tests/test_content_renderer.py: Test ContentRenderer generates valid HTML with required SEO elements (JSON-LD, meta tags, canonical URL, hreflang) for each page type.
acceptance_criteria: All new test files pass: pytest tests/test_knowledge_model.py tests/test_content_api.py tests/test_admin_knowledge.py tests/test_content_pipeline.py tests/test_seo_sitemaps.py tests/test_content_renderer.py
Tests cover auth guards, happy paths, error cases (404, validation), and pipeline orchestration
Tests use proper mocking for MongoDB and external services (no real DB/network calls)
Each test exercises actual new code paths and would fail if that code were reverted
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && pytest tests/test_knowledge_model.py tests/test_content_api.py tests/test_admin_knowledge.py tests/test_content_pipeline.py tests/test_seo_sitemaps.py tests/test_content_renderer.py -v --timeout=60
